title: Portuguese Cheese Tarts
description: A classic Portuguese dessert with a crispy flaky crust and a creamy cheese filling.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the dough circles into a muffin tin, pressing them into the corners.
In a bowl, mix together the cheese curds, granulated sugar, beaten egg, vanilla extract, and salt.
Spoon the cheese mixture into the dough-lined muffin tin.
Bake the tarts for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Allow the tarts to cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
